title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an unauthenticated user could gain administrator privileges through a user…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an unauthenticated user can gain administrator privileges by exploiting a flaw in the user-management REST API. The issue arises because the API incorrectly interprets numeric role names as role identifiers, allowing privilege escalation through role assignment.
